title: Completed module direct image with its finite-projection scalar action
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes $X,Y$ and $f:X\to Y$. On the small pro-etale sites use completed integral coefficient sheaves $B_X,B_Y$ and their finite projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and the base-change direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define the completed coefficient map $B_Y\to f_*B_X$ as the unique ring-sheaf map whose composite with every $f_*\pi_n$ is $\pi_n$ followed by the canonical constant finite-coefficient map. Define IntegralAmbient.push on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] as the actual continuous module direct image with scalar action restricted by this map. On an object $V\to Y$ its underlying sections are those over $X\times_Y V$; it acts on module maps by the same precomposition. This is an ordinary construction with no derived comparison assertion and no relation between scheme and coefficient universes.
